name: live-smoke
evidence_source: Public production probes from smoke.py --live. No credentials were read or recorded.

steps.name: live-probes
steps.command: python remote/deploy/smoke.py --live (public HTTPS probes; credential-dependent checks recorded as blocked)

signin-start.detail: GET https://flow-remote.vercel.app/ returned HTTP 200; gateway /healthz returned HTTP 200 with matching release SHA; OAuth start returned HTTP 302 to github.com; OAuth client id, state, frontend callback and state-cookie attributes were observed; deployed source declares Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict for the session cookie: True; the session cookie emitted after owner sign-in was not observed because this run cannot use owner credentials.

negative-paths.detail: bad-state callback HTTP 400 (expected 400); unauthenticated API HTTP 401 (expected 401); state-changing POST without X-Flow-Request HTTP 403 (expected 403).

sse.detail: Vercel stream probe with Last-Event-ID returned HTTP 401; authenticated connect and reconnect require the owner's signed-in browser session, which this task's credential restriction does not permit the executor to obtain.

telegram-delivery.detail: Not attempted: sending requires the owner's Telegram bot token and chat id; this task explicitly forbids reading or using credentials. No message was sent.

manual-handover.detail: Per the 2026-10-22 owner ruling, phone sign-in at 360 px and refusal of a foreign GitHub account remain manual handover steps and are not acceptance gates.

rollback: Follow remote/docs/runbook.md Step 7, then Steps 6 to 3 in order if sign-in or snapshot fail.
